description: Johannes C. Hellmuth, MD: physician-scientist, head of the DKTK Clinical Cooperation Unit Non-Coding Cancer Biology and attending physician for lymphoma at LMU Munich.
about: Johannes Hellmuth is a physician-scientist and attending physician in lymphoma care at the Department of Medicine III of the LMU University Hospital. He leads the DKTK Clinical Cooperation Unit “Non-Coding Cancer Biology” at the Institute of Pathology, LMU Munich, where his group studies how the non-coding genome and epigenome drive lymphoma pathogenesis.

publications.title: Unique immune cell coactivators specify locus control region function and cell stage
publications.summary: Our results demonstrate how an intimately linked complex of lineage- and stage-specific factors converges on specific and highly essential enhancer elements to drive the function of a cell-type defining LCR.

publications.title: Duodenal-type and nodal follicular lymphomas differ by their immune microenvironment rather than their mutation profiles
publications.summary: Duodenal-type follicular lymphoma (DTFL) is a rare and highly indolent follicular lymphoma (FL) variant. Comparative molecular characterization of DTFL to typical FL revealed distinct pathogenic mechanisms.
